'''Joey Quigley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Lexington tournament]] on 22 June 2001 with Bothan spy deck, Yavin 4 docking bay start, according to Stephen Cellucci's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2532">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrublandd2532/ lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrubland], DeckTech (Stephen "The Gov'na" Cellucci, 26 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-26-lexington-ma-6-22-01-aka-superscrublandd2532/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
